summary: C3 BrewFS Packed 观测开销实测 5.9836%/5.9841%，超过冻结门槛 5%。用户接受只报告端到端性能，观测器开销作为已披露的已知偏差进入新一批，不改写已验收的 14/28，不回填旧批次。

applies_to.scope_note: 本条只对这一臂的新一批正式样本有效；不适用于 native/entity-native/juicefs 臂，也不适用于其他 C3 单元或其他套件。

deviation.statistic: abs(median(paired on/off relative change)) over >=3 pairs, for both makespan and task_p99
deviation.decision_rule: passed = all(relative_changes[name] <= max_relative_change for name in (makespan, task_p99))

checker.hard_cap: line 295-296 raises when len(pairs) < 3 or not 0 < max_relative_change <= 0.05
checker.paired_work_signature: lines 311-322 reject any pair whose measured work signature differs
checker.scope_string: three or more paired fresh mounts; no same-process causal claim; rerun if binary, sampler interval or target density changes

reasons.rule: config.telemetry must equal exactly {interval_seconds:5, max_gap_seconds:30, max_relative_overhead:0.05}
the checker itself refuses a tolerance above 0.05
sample-side observer_overhead max_relative_change must not exceed the plan tolerance

cannot_be_expressed_as_plan_parameter.consequence: deviation must be recorded and disclosed at batch level; it must not be implemented by editing the plan field or the checker tolerance

deviation.threshold_after_deviation: not substituted and not raised; the measured value is reported as-is and the deviation is disclosed with every result

measured.direction: observation-on faster than observation-off in 2 of 3 pairs; sign is negative, so this is not a uniform slowdown factor
measured.where_the_difference_sits: cold-read work phase; slower/faster attribution to collector, cache or object backend is not established

decision.statement: 可以只观测端到端性能，不介意观测开销超过 5%。
decision.interpretation: report end-to-end performance only; record the observer overhead as a disclosed known bias instead of hiding it
not_authorized: claiming equal comparability with the already accepted flat arms without also reporting each arm's own deviation
silently raising or bypassing the 5% threshold
applying this deviation to any other arm or cell
rescaling or dividing measured numbers by 1.0598 as if the bias were a constant factor

required_fields_in_every_result: measured observer overhead value and the three per-pair relative changes
the phase where the difference sits and the explicit statement that it is not attributed
the statement that all other gates are unchanged
disclosure.result_template: 在 5.98% 观测开销（三对配对相对差中位数绝对值；逐对 -6.21% / +0.42% / -5.98%，方向为开采集更快，差异集中在 cold-read，未归因）下，C3 packed 单轮端到端 makespan 为 <value> 秒。
disclosure.short_label: 5.98% 观测开销下的端到端性能
forbidden_phrasings: 与 flat 结果同等可比（单独出现）
把 5.98% 当作校正系数折算数字
disclosure.cross_arm_rule: any cross-arm comparison must print both arms' own observer deviations side by side; C3 flat BrewFS is 2.85%/2.86% (passed), C3 JuiceFS has its own retained calibration, C3 packed is 5.98% (failed gate, disclosed).

unchanged_gates.requirement: build-manifest.json and input-manifest.json SHA must equal the frozen plan fields
packed cloud route qualification filesystem.json passed
upload_before_commit + fsync + remote drain with zero pending bytes/operations
actual capacity budget with 20% reserve and seven further copies
complete immutable packed base, 100,000 files / 409,600,000 bytes, plus a different private child with child and parent cold checks
client cache provenance recorded in the formal cell
cross-pool hardware proof when required by the cell
observe-start, create-w01, mount-w01, measure-w01, drain-w01, unmount-w01, verify-w01, observe-stop, archive
verify-w01 full content verification after remount; a fresh complete cold verification for the formal cell, never reused from qualification
same metric_contract_sha256 and workload_contract_sha256 as the frozen qualification; work-check passed
interval 5 s, max gap 30 s, all four phase marks; only the allowed relative difference is deviated
real process exit, mount absent, agent slot empty, zero upload debt
three-role raw archives retained with member SHA verification and independent remote readback

does_not_rewrite.no_backfill: no old batch, calibration trial or accepted receipt is re-scored, rerun, refilled or reinterpreted by this record

execution_status.reason: the deviation record alone is a reviewed authorization and disclosure artifact; the execution path still hard-requires a passing overhead gate

blockers.rule: requires checked['passed'] is True and every relative_changes value <= .05, else raises 'Three exact original calibration pairs within five percent required'
writes observer_overhead with equals={'passed': True}; a passed:false result fails sample acceptance via bench/suite_report.py:34
raises RuntimeError when the three pairs do not clear the existing gate; this is the recorded pipeline failure at stage pairs

missing_for_a_compliant_run.item: an explicit consumption point in admission and sample checking
missing_for_a_compliant_run.detail: admit_locked and the sample observer_overhead check must accept either passed:true or a reviewed:true reference to this record that satisfies the disclosure contract, and must carry that reference into context.json and the final result text
missing_for_a_compliant_run.type: code and new-batch request change; not a documentation change

evidence.name: pipeline failure at stage pairs
evidence.note: passed: false, stage: pairs, automatic_retry: false

evidence.name: qualification passed (filesystem, complete base plus cold child/parent)

not_found_or_uncovered: the overhead plan file itself (…/pairs/overhead/plan.json) is not archived in the repository; the result embeds pairs, max_relative_change and both contract SHAs, which is enough to rebuild the plan, but recomputation additionally needs the six cohort/result.json on the control host
causal attribution of the 5.98% difference to the collector, caches or the object backend is not established; evidence only localises it to the cold-read work phase
